chunks.text: It has come to the notice of the University Examination Branch that a fake circular claiming all semester examinations scheduled for next week have been postponed is circulating on WhatsApp and social media groups. Students are advised to note that no examinations have been postponed. All undergraduate and postgraduate examinations will be conducted strictly as per the notified date-sheet. Students should rely solely on the official university portal for announcements.
chunks.title: University Examination Branch: Clarification on Fake Examination Postponement Circulars

chunks.text: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) is the central bank and regulatory body responsible for the regulation of the Indian banking system and monetary policy. The official web portal of the Reserve Bank of India is hosted exclusively on rbi.org.in. All official circulars, monetary policy decisions, notifications, press releases, and regulatory directives are published directly on this portal. Citizens and financial institutions should rely strictly on rbi.org.in for verified communications.
chunks.title: Reserve Bank of India: Official Web Portal and Central Banking Information Registry

chunks.text: SBI never sends links over SMS asking customers to update KYC. Official KYC updates are conducted strictly through official SBI branches or the official SBI YONO mobile app. Cyber criminals are circulating deceptive SMS and WhatsApp messages claiming that user YONO bank accounts have been blocked due to outdated KYC documents and urging recipients to click external links under threat of financial penalty.
chunks.source_name: State Bank of India Official Security Advisory
chunks.title: State Bank of India & RBI Advisory: Fake KYC Expiration and Account Block SMS Alerts

chunks.text: Cyber criminals are circulating deceptive SMS and WhatsApp messages claiming that user YONO bank accounts have been blocked due to outdated KYC documents and urging recipients to click external links under threat of financial penalty. The Reserve Bank of India and SBI emphasize that banks will never ask customers to verify passwords, debit card PINs, CVV, or one-time passwords through SMS web links.
chunks.source_name: State Bank of India Official Security Advisory
chunks.title: State Bank of India & RBI Advisory: Fake KYC Expiration and Account Block SMS Alerts

chunks.text: The Reserve Bank of India and SBI emphasize that banks will never ask customers to verify passwords, debit card PINs, CVV, or one-time passwords through SMS web links. Customers must never share login credentials, OTPs, or debit card PINs on external portals or links received via SMS. If you receive such an SMS, do not click the link and immediately report the incident to the official national cyber crime portal.
chunks.source_name: State Bank of India Official Security Advisory
chunks.title: State Bank of India & RBI Advisory: Fake KYC Expiration and Account Block SMS Alerts

chunks.text: A message is circulating on social media claiming that the Government of India is providing free laptops to all students. This claim is FAKE. No such scheme is being operated by the central government. Fraudulent messages frequently share deceptive web addresses claiming that students who passed 10th or 12th standards can register for free laptops by submitting Aadhaar numbers and personal contact information.
chunks.title: PIB Fact Check: Viral Messages Claiming Free Laptop Distribution Under Government Scheme Are Fake

chunks.text: Fraudulent messages frequently share deceptive web addresses claiming that students who passed 10th or 12th standards can register for free laptops by submitting Aadhaar numbers and personal contact information. The Press Information Bureau cautions citizens that the Central Government runs no scheme titled PM Free Laptop Distribution Scheme. Official academic support and scholarship programs are managed strictly through verified domains such as scholarships.gov.in.
chunks.title: PIB Fact Check: Viral Messages Claiming Free Laptop Distribution Under Government Scheme Are Fake

chunks.text: Official academic support and scholarship programs are managed strictly through verified domains such as scholarships.gov.in. Citizens are advised not to share personal credentials or register on unverified third-party websites claiming to distribute free electronic devices.
chunks.title: PIB Fact Check: Viral Messages Claiming Free Laptop Distribution Under Government Scheme Are Fake

chunks.text: There is no scientific basis to claim an alkaline diet or consuming sodium bicarbonate neutralizes or cures cancer in humans. Dietary changes cannot alter systemic blood pH. Human blood pH is strictly regulated by the kidneys and respiratory system within a narrow pH range of 7.35 to 7.45 regardless of food or beverage intake.
chunks.title: American Cancer Society: Alkaline Diets, Baking Soda, and Cancer Cell Myths

chunks.text: Human blood pH is strictly regulated by the kidneys and respiratory system within a narrow pH range of 7.35 to 7.45 regardless of food or beverage intake. Proponents of alternative alkaline therapies often claim that cancer cells cannot survive in an alkaline environment; while isolated cell cultures in petri dishes behave differently, in living human physiology stomach acid rapidly neutralizes ingested sodium bicarbonate and lemon juice.
chunks.title: American Cancer Society: Alkaline Diets, Baking Soda, and Cancer Cell Myths

chunks.text: Proponents of alternative alkaline therapies often claim that cancer cells cannot survive in an alkaline environment; while isolated cell cultures in petri dishes behave differently, in living human physiology stomach acid rapidly neutralizes ingested sodium bicarbonate and lemon juice. Delaying evidence-based oncology treatment in favor of unproven home remedies such as lemon and baking soda mixtures puts patients at severe life-threatening risk.
chunks.title: American Cancer Society: Alkaline Diets, Baking Soda, and Cancer Cell Myths

chunks.text: The new Delhi Metro extension opens for passenger operations tomorrow following statutory safety clearance. Standard fare rules apply from day one. Tickets are not free during the first week, and normal token or smart-card fares will be deducted. While concessionary travel cards exist for registered students across public transit networks, there is no blanket 100% free travel week or newly announced monthly subsidy.
chunks.source_name: Delhi Metro Rail Corporation (DMRC) Official Notification
chunks.title: Delhi Metro Rail Corporation: Phase 4 Extension Commercial Opening and Ticketing Guidelines

chunks.text: Drinking hot water or frequently sipping warm water does not kill viruses or cure viral respiratory infections. While staying hydrated is beneficial for overall wellness, drinking water cannot flush viruses from the respiratory tract or kill them in the stomach. The World Health Organization confirms that viral pathogens replicate inside mucosal epithelial cells, and normal drinking water temperatures cannot neutralize viral loads without causing bodily thermal burns.
chunks.title: World Health Organization: Fact Sheet on Water Consumption, Body Temperature, and Viral Infections

chunks.text: The World Health Organization confirms that viral pathogens replicate inside mucosal epithelial cells, and normal drinking water temperatures cannot neutralize viral loads without causing bodily thermal burns. Medical consensus refutes the claim that drinking water every 15 or 30 minutes eliminates viruses.
chunks.title: World Health Organization: Fact Sheet on Water Consumption, Body Temperature, and Viral Infections

chunks.text: Consuming lemon, sodium bicarbonate, or acidic/alkaline remedies has not been shown to treat internal chronic pathologies or metabolic malignancies. Misinformation claiming that common household ingredients eliminate complex diseases in 24 to 48 hours is rampant across messaging apps. Home remedies cannot replace verified medical treatment prescribed by qualified healthcare professionals.
chunks.title: World Health Organization: Mythbusters on Viral Health Remedies and Disease Cures

chunks.text: Home remedies cannot replace verified medical treatment prescribed by qualified healthcare professionals. The World Health Organization monitors viral health hoaxes and urges the public to seek evidence-based clinical guidance from national public health ministries.
chunks.title: World Health Organization: Mythbusters on Viral Health Remedies and Disease Cures
